page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i4.16xlarge is a storage-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture, driven by Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing an allocation of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, which includes 15358 GB of bundled SSD storage. This high-density local storage is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps, enabling rapid data transfer rates and low-latency I/O operations. The combination of dedicated compute resources, high memory capacity, and extensive local SSD storage makes this instance highly efficient for data-intensive workloads without the need for external storage attachments.

The ecs.i4.16xlarge is designed for workloads requiring high-throughput local storage and substantial memory capacity. It is highly suited for large-scale relational databases, NoSQL databases, distributed file systems, and real-time data analytics. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the integration of extensive local SSD storage directly into the instance profile reduces the overhead and latency associated with network-attached storage, offering a high-density resource profile for storage-heavy enterprise applications.
